contestants.description: Blends a poll-average proxy with the market price; buys whichever side the blend favors by more than 4c.
Fades single-day price moves larger than 8c, betting on snap-back toward the recent mean.
Buys the side that gained over the trailing 3 days; rides information-driven drifts.
Scales into the then-favorite side every 4th day and holds to settlement; tests whether favorites are underpriced.
Buys YES only when priced 5c-20c; tests whether cheap tails are systematically mispriced.
Buys YES on volume spikes above 2x the trailing average; tests volume-as-information.
Trades toward a fundamentals 'rating' proxy whenever price deviates by more than 6c.
Buys YES below 45c and NO-side exposure above 55c; mean-reverting inventory style.

note: Project-designed simulated contestants. Usernames are fictional handles for paper-trading strategies, not real people. Each strategy's rules are implemented in scripts/paper_trading.py (decide()).
